digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and deprecation registry
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled(...) with remove_in=_MAJOR to deprecate it in favor of per-class slots (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_REASONER_MODEL)
Deprecation warnings must be emitted at exactly two env-read sites: config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py during slot parsing, each warning independently when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set
When only REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set with no explicit class configuration, it must map to all three classes as a fallback default
User-facing references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL in CLI help, MCP tool descriptions, and docstrings must be updated to present class configuration as current interface
Example configs for Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, and local+fallback scenarios must be added to docs as complete pasted [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables
